title: MIOT Gateway Configuration Schema
description: Schema for MIOT Gateway device configuration

config_version.description: Configuration version number, increments on local changes

MQTT_URL.description: MQTT broker URL (null if not configured)

OTA_URL.description: OTA update server URL (null if not configured)

configure_units.description: Mapping of sensor types to their Modbus address register. Used during configuration mode to identify and assign addresses to new devices.

additionalProperties.description: Modbus register address (decimal) that holds the unit address for this sensor type

units.description: Object containing all connected Modbus units

unit_address.description: Current Modbus slave address assigned to this unit (2-247)

unit_wifi_interval.description: Update interval in seconds when connected via WiFi

unit_NB-IOT_interval.description: Update interval in seconds when connected via NB-IoT (typically longer to save data)

unit_type.description: Sensor type identifier matching a key in configure_units (e.g., MIOT_Level_Sensor)

IO_config.description: Object containing all I/O configurations for this unit

io.description: If IO_function_code is omitted the firmware defaults to FC3 (read) and FC6 (write) for backwards compatibility with older configs.

IO_function_code.description: List of Modbus function codes used by this I/O. Omit entirely to use legacy defaults (FC3 read + FC6 write). Read codes (1-4) and write codes (5,6,15,16) are non-overlapping, so the firmware infers direction from the value. Read codes: 1 (Read Coils), 2 (Read Discrete Inputs), 3 (Read Holding Registers), 4 (Read Input Registers). Write codes: 5 (Write Single Coil), 6 (Write Single Register), 15 (Write Multiple Coils), 16 (Write Multiple Registers).

IO_read_address.description: Modbus register address to read from

IO_start_byte.description: Starting byte position in the register data

IO_unit.description: Unit of measurement (can be empty string)

min.description: Minimum expected value for this I/O (optional)

max.description: Maximum expected value for this I/O (optional)

accuracy.description: Decimal precision for displaying the value (optional)

IO_endian.description: Byte order for multi-byte values. 'big' (default, Modbus standard) or 'little'. Omitting this field defaults to big-endian.
